scope: Directional entry-event attribution instead of consumer-only attribution
Source-fair, four UTC+8 window, uniform-rank signal sampling
Bounded frozen rejection operands, thresholds and source provenance
Concrete Chinese reason summaries with UTF-16 notification bounds
Exact CJK contract identities through intake, orders, protection and settlement
Research-only fixed volume-gate sensitivity, never automatic policy tuning

validation.database: Disposable Unix-socket PostgreSQL with isolated-cluster identity guard
validation.network: V2 conftest denies external socket connections; venue operations are strict in-memory fakes
validation.unicode_full_cycle: Signals, intent, order/fill, protection recovery, reduce-only close, income, cash and settlement; replay does not duplicate writes or accounting
validation.initial_fixture_failure: A test tried to insert a secret-named field; the existing business-evidence credential guard correctly refused it. The fixture was corrected without bypassing that guard.

historical_read_only_check.transaction: REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY, 3 second statement timeout, 100 millisecond lock timeout, bounded total budget
historical_read_only_check.cutoff: Original sent report evidence as_of_ms, not current-day decision information

compatibility_and_release_conditions: Current workspace includes unrelated existing modifications. Do not deploy the entire dirty tree as this patch.
Controller, market hub and TradingView ingress need coordinated symbol-boundary upgrades; reporting needs its own compatible package.
Catalog supported flags must refresh naturally under the new hub. Do not hand-edit cached flags.
Venue listing, status, risk, quantity precision and environment checks remain mandatory. Syntax acceptance is not trade permission.
Existing ASCII event and frame identities are unchanged. Unicode frame and standard Pine event identities use exact UTF-8 SHA-256 components.
Once a CJK position exists, do not roll back to an ASCII-only controller, inventory reader or protection adapter.
No broad restart or forced close was authorized or performed as part of this implementation. Runtime activation remains a separate coordinated release step.
Independent onchain research symbol mappings were not expanded; that research module must remain optional and non-blocking.
